title.ar: اخْتِبارُ تَحْديدِ المُسْتَوى لِلْبَدْءِ بِالكِتابِ الثّالِث

intro.en: This test checks your words before Book 3: opposites, groups of words (like energy or illness), and words about Islam and the modern world. Study the word tiles first, then try the quiz.
intro.ur: Yeh test Book 3 se pehle aap ke alfaaz parakhta hai: ulte alfaaz, alfaaz ke groups (jaise energy ya beemari), aur Islam aur jadeed duniya ke alfaaz. Pehle word tiles dekhein, phir quiz karein.
intro.ar: يَخْتَبِرُ هَذَا الدَّرْسُ مُفْرَداتِكَ قَبْلَ الكِتابِ الثّالِث: الأَضْدادَ، وَالكَلِماتِ الجامِعَةَ (كَالطّاقَةِ وَالمَرَضِ)، وَكَلِماتٍ عَنِ الإِسْلامِ وَالعالَمِ الحَديث. تَعَلَّمْ بِطاقاتِ الكَلِماتِ أَوَّلاً ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَة.

vocab.ur: us ne kheti ki / bo diya

q.en: What is the opposite of الفَقير (the poor)?
Which one word covers: كَهْرَباء، وَقود، نَفْط، بُخار?
q.ur: Kaunsa ek lafz in sab ko jama karta hai: كَهْرَباء، وَقود، نَفْط، بُخار?
q.ar: ما الكَلِمَةُ الَّتي تَجْمَعُ: كَهْرَباء، وَقود، نَفْط، بُخار؟

q.en: Which one word covers: صُداع، زُكام، أَلَم، حُمَّى?
q.ur: Kaunsa ek lafz in sab ko jama karta hai: صُداع، زُكام، أَلَم، حُمَّى?
q.ar: ما الكَلِمَةُ الَّتي تَجْمَعُ: صُداع، زُكام، أَلَم، حُمَّى؟

q.en: What is the opposite of الحَرْب (war)?
Which one word covers: جَريمَة، عِقاب، شُرْطَة، سَرِقَة?
q.ur: Kaunsa ek lafz in sab ko jama karta hai: جَريمَة، عِقاب، شُرْطَة، سَرِقَة?
q.ar: ما الكَلِمَةُ الَّتي تَجْمَعُ: جَريمَة، عِقاب، شُرْطَة، سَرِقَة؟

intro.en: Here you choose the correct verb form, fix mistakes in words, and answer grammar questions. Example: after لَنْ the verb loses its final ن in the 'five verbs': يا أَبْنائي لَنْ تَذْهَبوا غَداً (O my sons, you will not go tomorrow).
intro.ur: Yahan aap sahi fe'l chunte hain, ghaltiyan theek karte hain aur grammar ke sawalon ke jawab dete hain. Misaal: لَنْ ke baad 'paanch fe'l' ka aakhri ن gir jaata hai: يا أَبْنائي لَنْ تَذْهَبوا غَداً (Mere bacho, tum kal nahin jaoge).
intro.ar: في هَذَا الدَّرْسِ تَخْتارُ صيغَةَ الفِعْلِ الصَّحيحَةَ، وَتُصَحِّحُ أَخْطاءَ الكَلِمات، وَتُجيبُ عَنْ أَسْئِلَةٍ في القَواعِد. مِثال: بَعْدَ «لَنْ» يَسْقُطُ النّونُ مِنَ الأَفْعالِ الخَمْسَة: يا أَبْنائي لَنْ تَذْهَبوا غَداً.

q.en: The five nouns (الأَسْماء الخَمْسَة) are put in the genitive (جَرّ) with:
q.ur: Paanch ism jarr mein kis cheez se aate hain?

q.en: The dual (المُثَنَّى) is put in the accusative (نَصْب) with:
q.ur: Mussanna nasb mein kis cheez se aata hai?

q.en: The five verbs (الأَفْعال الخَمْسَة) are put in the jussive (جَزْم) by:
q.ur: Paanch fe'l jazm mein kaise aate hain?

q.en: The sound masculine plural is put in the nominative (رَفْع) with:
q.ur: Jam' muzakkar saalim raf' mein kis se aata hai?

q.en: The present verb after أَنْ or لَنْ is:
q.ur: أَنْ ya لَنْ ke baad fe'l muzaare' kya hota hai?

title.en: Placement test: reading, writing and Islamic culture
title.ur: Placement test: parhna, likhna aur Islami saqaafat

intro.en: Read the passage about how Muslim learning influenced the world, then answer questions. Next come writing tasks (ordering words, fixing spelling) and everyday Islamic phrases such as يَرْحَمُكَ اللّٰه after a sneeze.
intro.ur: Woh ibaarat parhein jo batati hai ke Musalmanon ke ilm ne duniya ko kaise mutaassir kiya, phir sawalon ke jawab dein. Uske baad likhne ke kaam (alfaaz ki tarteeb, imla ki ghaltiyan) aur rozmarra Islami jumle, jaise chheenk par يَرْحَمُكَ اللّٰه.
intro.ar: اقْرَأْ نَصَّ تَأْثيرِ العُلومِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ في العالَم، ثُمَّ أَجِبْ عَنِ الأَسْئِلَة. بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ تَأْتي تَمارينُ الكِتابَةِ (تَرْتيبُ الكَلِماتِ وَتَصْحيحُ الإِمْلاء) وَعِباراتٌ إِسْلامِيَّةٌ يَوْمِيَّةٌ مِثْلُ «يَرْحَمُكَ اللّٰه» بَعْدَ العُطاس.

dialogue.ar: تَأَثَّرَتْ شُعوبٌ كَثيرَةٌ بِحَضارَةِ المُسْلِمينَ، وَأَكْثَرُها تَأَثُّراً أَهْلُ أُوروبّا.
dialogue.tr: taʾathtarat shuʿūbun kathīratun biḥaḍārati l-muslimīn wa-ʾaktharuhā taʾathturan ahlu ūrūbbā
dialogue.en: Many peoples were influenced by the civilization of the Muslims, the most influenced being the people of Europe.
dialogue.ur: Bohat si qaumein Musalmanon ki tehzeeb se mutaassir huin, aur sab se ziyada Europe ke log.

dialogue.ar: في العَصْرِ العَبّاسِيِّ كانَ العُلَماءُ يَنْشُرونَ العِلْمَ وَالثَّقافَةَ، فَوَصَلَتْ مَعارِفُهُمْ إِلى مَناطِقَ واسِعَةٍ.
dialogue.tr: fī l-ʿaṣri l-ʿabbāsiyyi kāna l-ʿulamāʾu yanshurūna l-ʿilma wath-thaqāfa fa-waṣalat maʿārifuhum ilā manāṭiqa wāsiʿa
dialogue.en: In the Abbasid era scholars kept spreading knowledge and culture, so their learning reached wide regions.
dialogue.ur: Abbasi daur mein ulama ilm aur saqafat phailate rahe, yahan tak ke unka ilm wasee ilaqon tak pahunch gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَبَلَغَ التُّجّارُ وَالرَّحّالَةُ حُدودَ الصّينِ شَرْقاً، وَشَواطِئَ المُحيطِ الأَطْلَسِيِّ غَرْباً.
dialogue.tr: wa-balagha t-tujjāru war-raḥḥālatu ḥudūda ṣ-ṣīni sharqā wa-shawāṭiʾa l-muḥīṭi l-ʾaṭlasiyyi gharbā
dialogue.en: Merchants and travellers reached the borders of China in the east and the shores of the Atlantic Ocean in the west.
dialogue.ur: Tajir aur sayyah mashriq mein China ki sarhadon tak aur maghrib mein Atlantic Ocean ke sahilon tak pahunche.

dialogue.ar: وَأَقامَ المُسْلِمونَ في مُدُنٍ كَثيرَةٍ مَعاهِدَ وَجامِعاتٍ، فَقَصَدَها الطُّلّابُ مِنْ كُلِّ بَلَدٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa-ʾaqāma l-muslimūna fī mudunin kathīratin maʿāhida wa-jāmiʿāt fa-qaṣadahā ṭ-ṭullābu min kulli balad
dialogue.en: The Muslims set up institutes and universities in many cities, and students came to them from every land.
dialogue.ur: Musalmanon ne kai shehron mein idare aur jamiaat qaim kin, aur har mulk se talaba un ki taraf aaye.

dialogue.ar: وَتَفَوَّقوا في الطِّبِّ وَالصَّيْدَلَةِ وَالرِّياضِيّاتِ وَالكيمياءِ تَفَوُّقاً كَبيراً.
dialogue.tr: wa-tafawwaqwā fī ṭ-ṭibbi waṣ-ṣaydalati war-riyāḍiyyāti wal-kīmyāʾi tafawwuqan kabīrā
dialogue.en: They excelled greatly in medicine, pharmacy, mathematics and chemistry.
dialogue.ur: Unhon ne tib, saidalah (pharmacy), riyaziyat aur kimiya mein bohat taraqqi ki.

dialogue.ar: وَسافَرَ عُلَماءُ مِنَ الغَرْبِ إِلى مُدُنِ الأَنْدَلُسِ لِيَتَعَلَّموا مِنْ أَساتِذَتِها.
dialogue.tr: wa-sāfara ʿulamāʾu mina l-gharbi ilā muduni l-ʾandalusi liyataʿallamwā min asātidhatihā
dialogue.en: Scholars from the West travelled to the cities of Andalusia to learn from its teachers.
dialogue.ur: Maghrib ke ulama Andalus ke shehron mein gaye taake wahan ke ustadon se seekhen.

dialogue.ar: وَتَرْجَمَ هَؤُلاءِ العُلَماءُ كُتُبَ المُسْلِمينَ إِلى لُغاتِهِمْ لِيَسْتَفيدَ مِنْها شَعْبُهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wa-tarjama haʾulāʾi l-ʿulamāʾu kutuba l-muslimīna ilā lughātihim liyastafīda minhā shaʿbuhum
dialogue.en: These scholars translated the Muslims' books into their own languages so that their people could benefit from them.
dialogue.ur: In ulama ne Musalmanon ki kitabon ka apni zubanon mein tarjuma kiya taake unki qaum faida uthaye.

dialogue.ar: وَدَرَّسَ أَساتِذَةُ الغَرْبِ هَذِهِ الكُتُبَ لِطُلّابِهِمْ زَمَناً طَويلاً.
dialogue.tr: wa-darrasa asātidhatu l-gharbi hadhihi l-kutuba liṭullābihim zamanan ṭawylā
dialogue.en: And the professors of the West taught these books to their students for a long time.
dialogue.ur: Aur maghrib ke ustadon ne ye kitabein apne talaba ko ek lambe arse tak parhayin.

vocab.en: may Allah reward you with good
may Allah have mercy on you
I leave you in Allah's care
vocab.ur: main aap ko Allah ke supurd karta hoon

q.en: According to the passage, which science is at the head of the list?
q.ur: Ibaarat ke mutaabiq kaunsa ilm sab se upar hai?
q.ar: حَسَبَ النَّصِّ، أَيُّ عِلْمٍ في رَأْسِ القائِمَة؟

q.en: What did scholars from the West do with the Muslims' books?
q.ur: Maghrib ke ulama ne Musalmanon ki kitabon ka kya kiya?
q.ar: ماذا فَعَلَ عُلَماءُ الغَرْبِ بِكُتُبِ المُسْلِمين؟

options: They translated them and taught them

q.en: In how many sciences does the passage say the Muslims excelled?
q.ur: Ibaarat ke mutabiq Musalman kitne uloom mein aage barhe?
q.ar: في كَمْ عِلْماً تَفَوَّقَ المُسْلِمونَ حَسَبَ النَّصّ؟

q.en: What do you say to someone who sneezed and said الحَمْدُ لِلّٰه?
q.ur: Jis ne chheenk kar الحَمْدُ لِلّٰه kaha, usse kya kehte hain?
q.ar: ماذا تَقولُ لِمَنْ عَطَسَ وَقالَ «الحَمْدُ لِلّٰه»؟

q.en: What do you say to someone who is about to travel?
q.ur: Safar karne wale se kya kehte hain?
